printedNotes.paraphrase: OIC and Other Employees salary schedules may include base salary, retroactive pay, benefits from prior years and current-year vacation payouts.
Deputy and Associate Deputy salary and other compensation may include base salary, bonuses, retroactive pay, car or lease allowances, and vacation or benefit payments from prior and current years.

decisionBasis: Enumerated table preference for the full 45-row specialized deputy cohort after review of the same fiscal period, published names and roles, and annual amounts. This is a project review decision, not an explicit provincial deduplication instruction.
preservation: All OIC observations are preserved in review/source-extraction.json.gzip. The specialized deputy records and directly reported travel are retained in the existing public-accounts collection. No general identity matching or amount-merging rule is introduced.
